title: Income Tax (First Home Saver Accounts Misuse Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase the Medicare levy component used to calculate tax on improper use of First Home Saver Accounts for a first-home purchase.
It would set that component at 2 per cent within the adjusted maximum tax rate, which also includes the maximum income tax rate.
The amendment would apply to account payments made from 1 July 2014 and form part of the broader DisabilityCare Australia tax amendment package.
changes: The Medicare levy component of the misuse-tax calculation would increase to 2 per cent.
The definition of adjusted maximum tax rate would be amended.
The revised calculation would cover account payments made on or after 1 July 2014.
summary.affected: Individuals who improperly use a First Home Saver Account and receive payments to buy a first home are affected.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Proposed matching consequential amendments raising the First Home Saver Accounts misuse tax rate from 46.5 to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, aligning it with the Medicare levy increase from 1.5 to two per cent that funds DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
